hint: Shows a hint message when you stand on it.
popwall: Recessed wall; becomes solid after you step off it.
fake_floor: Looks like a wall but is actually walkable.
fake_wall: Looks like floor but is actually solid.
popdown_floor: Floor that turns into wall once you cross it.
popdown_wall: The solid form of a popdown tile.
canopy: Overhead cover that hides whatever is beneath it.
wall_invisible: Invisible wall; only shows for a moment when bumped.
wall_appearing: Invisible wall that stays visible once bumped.
dirt: Soft ground; cleared when you step on it. Blocks monsters.
gravel: Rough ground; blocks monsters but not you.
sand: Slows down blocks pushed through it.
hole: A pit; blocks pushed in fall and fill it.
cracked_floor: Collapses into a hole right after you leave it.
exit: The goal — reach it to finish the duty (level).
socket: Locked exit; opens once you've collected every chip.
no_player1_sign: Blocks player 1 from entering this tile.
no_player2_sign: Blocks player 2 from entering this tile.
thief_tools: Steals all your tools when stepped on.
thief_keys: Steals all your keys when stepped on.
thin_walls: A wall on a cell edge; blocks that one side only.
one_way_walls: Passable from one direction, solid from the other.
water: Drowns you unless you have flippers.
fire: Burns you unless you have fire boots.
turtle: Temporary stepping stone over water; sinks after use.
ice: You slide until you hit something (ice skates let you stop).
cracked_ice: Ice that breaks into water after one crossing.
green_floor: Toggle floor; swaps with green walls when a green button is hit.
green_wall: Toggle wall; swaps with green floor on a green button.
purple_floor: Toggle floor tied to purple toggle walls.
purple_wall: Toggle wall tied to purple toggle floor.
force_floor_all: Shoves you in a rotating/random direction.
railroad: Train track; things ride along the rails.
dash_floor: Speed strip — moves you along faster.
chip: A required collectible; gather them all to open the exit.
flippers: Tool — lets you swim across water.
cleats: Ice skates — let you stop and steer on ice.
suction_boots: Tool — lets you walk normally on force floors.
bribe: Tool — bribes a thief so it won't rob you.
railroad_sign: Tool — lets you ride the railroad.
foil: Tool — turn walls into recessed walls by bumping them.
helmet: Tool — protects your head (from falling blocks etc.).
bowling_ball: Tool — throw it to knock out creatures.
dynamite: Tool — place and detonate to clear tiles.
bomb: Explodes and kills whatever steps on it.
no_sign: Marker that prevents something being placed/entering.
gift_bow: Wraps an item as a gift/reward.
toll_gate: Gate that needs a bribe/toll to pass.
dumbbell: Tool — makes you heavier (resist being pushed).
key_red: Red key — opens red doors (used up).
key_blue: Blue key — opens blue doors (used up).
key_yellow: Yellow key — opens yellow doors (used up).
key_green: Green key — opens ALL green doors (kept).
door_red: Locked door; needs a red key.
door_blue: Locked door; needs a blue key.
door_yellow: Locked door; needs a yellow key.
door_green: Locked door; needs the green key.
teleport_red: Warps you to another red teleporter.
teleport_blue: Warps you to another blue teleporter.
teleport_yellow: Warps you to another yellow teleporter.
teleport_green: Warps you to another green teleporter.
transmogrifier: Transforms any creature that passes through it.
turntable_cw: Rotates things on the rails clockwise.
turntable_ccw: Rotates things on the rails counter-clockwise.
button_blue: Blue button — reverses all blue tanks.
button_green: Green button — flips all green toggle walls/floors.
button_red: Red button — activates the connected cloning machine.
button_brown: Brown button — frees a creature from its trap.
button_pink: Pink button — powers wiring while held.
cloner: Cloning machine — copies the object on it when its button is hit.
trap: Holds a creature in place until a brown button frees it.
dirt_block: Pushable block; fills water when pushed in.
ice_block: Pushable block; slides on ice, freezes water.
glass_block: Pushable block that can encase an item.
green_block: Pushable block that hides a bomb/mine.
log: Rolling log; floats and can bridge water.
player: You — Jarvis. Faces 4 ways; animates for walk, push, swim, slide, burn.
player2: Second player (Cerise) for two-character levels — full 4-way rig.
tank_blue: Tank — drives straight; reverses on a blue button.
tank_yellow: Tank — moves only when a yellow button is pressed.
glider: Glider — flies straight, turns left when blocked.
ghost: Ghost — drifts and passes through some things.
walker: Walker — moves straight, random turn when blocked.
teeth: The hound — chases you directly. Deadly on contact.
teeth_timid: Timid hound — flees from you instead of chasing.
rover: Rover — a robot that mimics different monsters. Large sprite.
floor_mimic: Disguised as floor until you get close — then it strikes.
ball: Bouncing ball — reverses when it hits a wall.
rolling_ball: A ball you can kick; rolls until it hits something.
dynamite_lit: Lit dynamite counting down to explode.
